description: This file defines the UserService class, which manages user authentication, account management, credential changes, and related security operations within a software project. It handles sign-in, registration, account deletion, protocol upgrades, passcode management, and event handling, integrating with various services and interfaces.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class managing user authentication, account lifecycle, credential updates, and security features, integrating with various subsystems and handling user-related events.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles internal events, specifically user sign-in or registration, to reset sync state and manage local data accordingly.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs cleanup by nullifying references to external services.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user account with email and password, optionally merging local data.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password, with options for strictness, ephemerality, merging local data, and sync behavior.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes the user account after authorization, then signs out and shows an alert.

methods.name: submitUserRequest
methods.description: Submits a user request of a specified type to the server.

methods.name: correctiveSignIn
methods.description: Performs a sign-in using a root key to fix missing keys or data inconsistencies.

methods.name: changeCredentials
methods.description: Changes user credentials (email/password) with optional passcode, handling validation and server update.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the user, optionally forcing sign-out and handling unsynced local changes.

methods.name: performProtocolUpgrade
methods.description: Handles protocol upgrade process, including challenge prompts and passcode updates.

methods.name: addPasscode
methods.description: Adds a passcode to the account after authorization.

methods.name: removePasscode
methods.description: Removes the account passcode after authorization.

methods.name: changePasscode
methods.description: Changes the account passcode with authorization and user prompts.

methods.name: populateSessionFromDemoShareToken
methods.description: Populates user session from a demo share token and triggers sign-in event.

methods.name: setPasscodeWithoutWarning
methods.description: Sets a new passcode and updates root key, then rewrites item keys and syncs.

methods.name: removePasscodeWithoutWarning
methods.description: Removes passcode and updates item keys.

methods.name: rewriteItemsKeys
methods.description: Rewrites item encryption keys to local storage, deleting unencrypted logs.

methods.name: lockSyncing
methods.description: Locks the sync process to prevent concurrent syncs.

methods.name: unlockSyncing
methods.description: Unlocks the sync process.

methods.name: clearDatabase
methods.description: Clears all payloads from local storage.

methods.name: performCredentialsChange
methods.description: Performs server-side credential change, handling rollback on failure.

methods.name: recomputeRootKeysForCredentialChange
methods.description: Recomputes current and new root keys for credential updates.
